_comment: Permission policy for agentic PC control (requirement 20). Each category is allow | ask | deny. 'ask' prompts the user in the overlay before the action runs. Destructive, irreversible, or outbound-data actions default to 'ask' even inside an 'allow' category. Every action is written to the audit log regardless. Edit this file to widen or restrict JARVIS. See docs/SECURITY.md.
never_allowed: Actions that target computers other than this one
Hiding JARVIS from the user or from the OS (no stealth / no anti-detection)
Exfiltrating files or credentials to third parties without an explicit per-action confirmation
